(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀12 H7 hole (D4) is a tight fit on a part that receives I.Z.B.P. plating, but no allowance is made for the coating thickness; the plated bore will be undersize and may not accept its mating pin. The designer should either increase the pre-plate hole size to compensate for the plating thickness or add a note requiring reaming after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a pre-plate oversize dimension for D4 or specify reaming after surface treatment."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N11","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-(English) 1) TO BE HARDENED UPTO 32-35 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies hardness (32-35 HRC) but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment is to be performed (e.g., before final machining, before plating), which matters because hardening after precision machining can distort the calibrated features. The designer should add the process stage, such as 'HARDEN BEFORE FINAL MACHINING'." ,"recommended_correction":"Specify the manufacturing stage at which the heat treatment applies in note N11."}]}
